universe.exclusions: Uganda and South Sudan corridor targets are excluded from this round: the INSP per-zone table cannot resolve them, and their points are not GRID3 population peaks.
universe.rule: Targets are the GRID3 COD Health Zones v8.0 zones in every province holding a zone affected at the source data day, minus the affected zones. Affected means an officially integrated row of a reviewed SitRep health-zone table dated on or before the data day prints at least one confirmed case. The affected count and the scope total must equal the snapshot promotion's printed affected_health_zone_footprint. Uganda and South Sudan geographies are excluded.

review_receipt.reviewed_by: AI-assisted visual source review (founder-authorized production cadence)

scoring_policy.common_target_policy: all eligible models are evaluated on the identical evaluable target subset from a complete frozen matrix
scoring_policy.no_metric_shopping: round manifests freeze eligible metrics before outcomes
scoring_policy.uncertainty_policy: do not emit iid confidence intervals for one spatially correlated round; aggregate by round before clustered uncertainty
scoring_policy.undefined_metric_policy: emit null with reason when no evaluated rows or no outcome class variation
